dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nicole...! Weird, she's not here either...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Are you in my studio already? Did you notice my flower collection? I've been growing samples I collected from all over the world.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'm afraid I can't tear myself away right now. I've opened a stall in Fontaine selling sculptures.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uhm... Do you want us to help?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: No, thanks. This is my only chance to put pen to paper, even if I'm mostly just writing down numbers...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: But I know it's not often you get the time to visit, so feel free to start without me.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: By the way, I left you a scroll. I think I put it next to a statue of a finch near the west wall. Why don't you see if you can find it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Found it!

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Then let my silent guide help you on your way... Good luck!

talks.objective: Check the scroll left by Nicole
Follow the clues to place the statues in their correct positions

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Congratulations! Now, let me take a look... Mhm, good job!

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Unlike the current Witch's Garden, I stayed in this shrine when I was still an angel. This was my home for quite some time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So many angels! It looks like you were super popular, Nicole!

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: I don't want to blow my own trumpet, but everyone used to love listening to my stories — especially the ones about living among humans, sending them omens, and guiding them to build great civilizations.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Every time I got to a good bit, the other angels would stop what they were doing and hold their breaths, hanging onto my every word. You couldn't hear so much as a harp string tremble or a paintbrush scratch on the surface of a canvas...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: And then, the interwoven colors and hues would bloom. There would be music and light, illuminating everything in its golden splendor — a rapture of jubilation and joy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh, that sounds wonderful!

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Oh, it was, Paimon... It was.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Even though those wonderful days are gone, life remains full of happy surprises.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Wait a second... Someone actually had the gall to steal my sculptures while I was reading my newspaper? Oh, that's it for you, my foolish little friend! I'm going to guide you all the way to the Fortress of Meropide!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thought Nicole would be waiting for us inside. Isn't she home today?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It looks like this door can be pushed open. Do you think she's inside one of her rooms? We should go in and take a look.
